name: @affino/datagrid-plugins
author: Anton Pavlov <a.pavlov@affino.dev>
description: Plugin contracts and runtime helpers for Affino DataGrid

scripts.build: find src -type f -name '*.js' -delete && find src -type f -name '*.js.map' -delete && find src -type f -name '*.d.ts' -delete && find src -type f -name '*.d.ts.map' -delete && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ../../scripts/fix-esm-specifiers.mjs dist
